before.label: Historical demography & history of the family

Henry’s family reconstitution and Cambridge’s aggregate and household studies differ from Ariès’s historical concepts and Stone’s family interpretation. Pollock’s criticism questions evidence and sweeping changes in parental care. Lee and Wang’s Chinese population study challenges received Malthusian comparisons without making the field’s regional patterns uniform.
